title: Matching object as the limit over all proper faces
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with finite limits [def-galois-finite-limits-colimits], let $K$ be a simplicial object of $\mathcal C$ with simplicial operators $K(\varphi)$ and face maps $d_i$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object], and let $n\geq1$. Let $\mathcal I_n$ be the finite category whose objects are the injective order-preserving maps $\delta:[k]\to[n]$ with $0\leq k<n$, a morphism from $\delta':[k']\to[n]$ to $\delta:[k]\to[n]$ being an order-preserving map $\varepsilon:[k']\to[k]$ with $\delta\circ\varepsilon=\delta'$; let $P_n(K):\mathcal I_n^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$ be the diagram $\delta\mapsto K_k$ (for $\delta$ with source $[k]$), $\varepsilon\mapsto K(\varepsilon):K_k\to K_{k'}$. Let $\delta_i:[n-1]\to[n]$ be the increasing injection omitting $i$, and let $M_n(K)$, $\mathrm{pr}_i:M_n(K)\to K_{n-1}$ ($0\leq i\leq n$) and $\mu_n:K_n\to M_n(K)$ be the matching object, its projections and the matching morphism of [lem-weil-pbc-simplicial-matching-object]. Then: (1) for every object $W$ of $\mathcal C$, the map $(x_\delta)_\delta\mapsto(x_{\delta_0},\dots,x_{\delta_n})$ is a bijection, natural in $W$, from the families $(x_\delta:W\to K_k)_{\delta}$ indexed by the objects $\delta:[k]\to[n]$ of $\mathcal I_n$ with $K(\varepsilon)\circ x_\delta=x_{\delta\circ\varepsilon}$ for every morphism $\varepsilon$ of $\mathcal I_n$, onto the tuples $(x_0,\dots,x_n)$ of morphisms $x_i:W\to K_{n-1}$ with $d_{j-1}\circ x_i=d_i\circ x_j$ for all $0\leq i<j\leq n$; (2) for every object $\delta$ of $\mathcal I_n$ and every factorization $\delta=\delta_i\circ\varepsilon$ the morphism $\pi_\delta=K(\varepsilon)\circ\mathrm{pr}_i:M_n(K)\to K_k$ does not depend on the factorization, and $(M_n(K),(\pi_\delta)_\delta)$ is a limit cone of $P_n(K)$; (3) $\pi_\delta\circ\mu_n=K(\delta)$ for every object $\delta$ of $\mathcal I_n$, so $\mu_n$ is the unique morphism $K_n\to M_n(K)$ whose $\delta$-component is $K(\delta)$ for every $\delta$.

mathlib_searches.query: matching object of simplicial object as limit over proper faces equals limit over codimension one faces
the limit over all injective non-surjective maps [k] -> [n] of a simplicial object is the limit of the faces d_i with relations d_{j-1} x_i = d_i x_j (matching object, boundary of simplex)
